name: SpaceAnalysis
description: SpaceAnalysis: Nodes for analyzing architectural and urban spaces. Currently enables 2D grid-based pathfinding, visibility, and acoustics. Developed by Autodesk Research to support generative design explorations such as Project Discover. Tested with Dynamo 2.0.2, 2.1.0, 2.2.0, 2.2.1, 2.3.0
